description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4730219077520 ELBOW,PIPE TO TUBE: Line 0001 Qty 365 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
